description: The payload for creating an issue type

avatarId.description: The avatar ID of the issue type. Go to https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-avatars/\#api-rest-api-3-avatar-type-system-get to choose an avatarId existing in Jira

description.description: The description of the issue type

hierarchyLevel.description: The hierarchy level of the issue type. 0, 1, 2, 3 .. n; Negative values for subtasks

name.description: The name of the issue type

onConflict.description: The conflict strategy to use when the issue type already exists. FAIL - Fail execution, this always needs to be unique; USE - Use the existing entity and ignore new entity parameters
